# Rock Dance International

> Non-profit association (in formation) devoted to Up Rock / Rock Dance, the face-to-face battle dance born in Bushwick, Brooklyn, in the late 1960s. Fundamentals (Freestyle, Jerk, Burn, Apache Line), history, music, glossary, a list of every source, and the event in Barcelona, Spain, on Saturday, November 20, 2027. The exact venue, timetable and prices have not been announced.

A jerk is counted 1, 2, 3 and 4. Rockers dance to Funk and Soul, face to face without touching.

## Pages (English)

- [Get to know Up Rock.](https://rockdanceinternational.com/start-here/): A guided route through Up Rock: the dance, Freestyle, Jerks and Burns, the music and the Apache Line. Choose a page or follow all four steps.
- [Go a little deeper.](https://rockdanceinternational.com/explore/): Explore Up Rock history, music, glossary and original sources. Follow the timeline, look up a word or browse interviews and records.
- [Rock Dance International](https://rockdanceinternational.com/): Learn Up Rock, the battle dance from Bushwick, Brooklyn: Freestyle, Jerks and Burns. Rock Dance International meets in Barcelona, Spain, on Saturday, November 20, 2027.
- [What is Up Rock?](https://rockdanceinternational.com/what-is-up-rock/): Up Rock, the uprock dance also called rocking or rock dance, is a battle dance from New York: two rockers face off and improvise on the music. Explained from zero.
- [Up Rock history: where the dance began](https://rockdanceinternational.com/history/): Where the uprock dance began and how it spread: a sourced timeline from Bushwick, Brooklyn, in the late 1960s to rockers in Russia, Poland and Japan.
- [The four fundamentals of Up Rock](https://rockdanceinternational.com/fundamentals/): The uprock dance moves explained from zero: freestyle, jerk, burn and the Apache Line, and how rockers use them on the record in a battle.
- [The Apache Line in Up Rock](https://rockdanceinternational.com/fundamentals/apache-line/): In uprock dance, the Apache Line is the battle formation: two rows of rockers facing each other. How a battle in the line runs, its rules and its origins.
- [Up Rock vs toprock](https://rockdanceinternational.com/up-rock-vs-toprock/): Uprock vs toprock: toprock opens a breaking set, while Up Rock, the uprock dance, is a face-to-face battle for a whole record. Plus downrock and the names.
- [Up Rock glossary](https://rockdanceinternational.com/glossary/): What rockers mean by freestyle, jerk, burn, Apache Line, call out and rock contest: the uprock dance moves and words, each explained simply and sourced.
- [Up Rock music](https://rockdanceinternational.com/music/): Uprock songs: the funk and soul records and certain rock songs rockers battle to, why they dance the whole record, what happens on the break, and the DJs.
- [The OGs of Up Rock](https://rockdanceinternational.com/people/): The OGs of Up Rock: the rockers who built the dance in Brooklyn and the ones who kept it alive and took it abroad. Their pages are coming soon.
- [Up Rock crews](https://rockdanceinternational.com/crews/): Up Rock crews, from 1970s Brooklyn and the Bronx to crews in Europe and Asia today. The crew pages are coming soon.
- [Rock Dance International 2027](https://rockdanceinternational.com/event-2027/): Rock Dance International in Barcelona, Spain, on Saturday, November 20, 2027. Rock battles, Apache Lines, call-outs, workshops and open talk. More info coming soon.
- [Sources and archive](https://rockdanceinternational.com/sources/): Every source behind this site on Up Rock, linked to the original: oral histories, interviews, archived crew pages, books and records, with author and date.
- [About Rock Dance International](https://rockdanceinternational.com/about/): Who we are, how we check every fact about Up Rock before it goes online, and how crews, DJs, organizers and researchers can work with us.
- [Support Up Rock culture](https://rockdanceinternational.com/donate/): Where donations to Rock Dance International go: the website, research on Up Rock, interviews with OGs and rockers, artists and crews, and the 2027 event.
